capabilities: Plan novels with beat-sheet templates, outline trees, Kanban boards, and plot grids
Draft scenes in a distraction-light editor with timed sprints and inline fast-drafting markers
Track word goals, streaks, heatmaps, and deadline pace across projects
Revise with audit checklists, a revision log, and manuscript analysis
Compile and export manuscripts to Markdown, HTML, and Word, or PDF/epub via pandoc
extras: README includes an AI disclosure: implementation was AI-assisted but the plugin itself has a strict no-AI, no-text-generation policy. A sample vault is provided for trying it. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: I made Inkswell compatible with that format. Inkswell reads and writes the same longform frontmatter
motivation: The author is a long-time Longform plugin fan and wanted streamlined stage-by-stage workflows after seeing writing tools bloat with every possible feature; a work mandate to learn AI tooling also prompted the build.
problem: Obsidian has no dedicated, integrated tooling for planning, drafting, tracking, revising, and publishing long-form fiction inside a vault.

relations.evidence: Inkswell reads and writes the same longform frontmatter, so existing projects load with zero migration
shells out to a pandoc binary on your machine

summary: Fiction-writing suite that plans novels with beat sheets, boards, and story bible; drafts with sprints; tracks goals; audits revisions; and compiles exports.
